column1: # Differences scripts/surface-parity.sh accepts between the CLI and the web UI (#907).
#   pair     cli-web, the only pair with an allowlist. It covers both host cli vs host web and
#            container-cli vs container-web. cli == container-cli and web == container-web must hold
#            byte for byte and cannot be allowlisted.
#   pattern  a Go regular expression matched against the difference as
#            <path relative to the set root><TAB><type><TAB><line><TAB><confidence>; write the tab
#            between fields as the escape \t, since a literal tab ends the field
#   reason   the mechanism, verified in the code, and an issue reference (#NNN). An entry without
#            an issue reference is refused, and "differs today" is not a reason.
# Empty by default: on the golden inputs the CLI and the web UI report the same findings.
# docs/testing/SURFACE_PARITY.md says how to add an entry.
